ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Jindal Supreme (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Resignation — Jindal Supreme (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr. Narendra Singh, Plant Head being part of Senior Management of the company w.e.f. close of business hours on September 28, 2026.
Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP — Jindal Supreme (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
